北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风力 6 级，体感很冷！注意防风保暖，多喝水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is very cold with level 6 winds! Keep warm and hydrated.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，微风送爽，出门记得添衣哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny with a gentle breeze, remember to layer up.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感微凉。注意保暖，别着凉啦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and a bit cool. Stay warm and don't catch a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚，温暖宜人。出门享受好天气吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and pleasantly warm. Enjoy the lovely weather!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，暖洋洋的。心情也会很棒吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is beautifully sunny and warm. Hope you have a great day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 5℃。风有点凉，记得多穿点。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny, feels like 5℃. It's a bit windy, remember to layer up.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 3℃。出门注意保暖，别感冒哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like 3℃. Stay warm when going out, don't catch a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗，气温 8℃。注意早晚温差，多添衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny, 8℃. Mind the temperature difference between day and night, dress warmly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 6℃。注意保暖，多喝热水哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 6℃. Keep warm and drink plenty of hot water.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 1℃。天气干燥，注意防寒补水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels like 1℃. It's dry and cold, stay warm and hydrated.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，气温 9℃。出门记得戴口罩，注意健康。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, 9℃. Remember to wear a mask when going out, stay healthy.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -26℃，超冷！全副武装，注意防冻哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -26℃, extremely cold! Bundle up, beware of frostbite.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -26℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 -13℃，出门一定要穿厚点，别冻着。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -13℃, dress warmly when going out, don't get cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气温 10℃。早晚温差大，别忘了添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, 10℃. Mind the day-night temperature difference, remember to layer up.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阳光正好，体感 9℃。风有点凉，记得添衣哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 9℃. It's a bit windy, remember to layer up.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感 -6℃，风力 4 级。注意防风保暖，多喝水。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like -6℃ with level 4 winds. Stay warm, protected from wind, and hydrated.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -12℃。风力大，多穿点，注意防寒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -12℃. It's windy, dress warmly, and stay protected from cold.
